# Graphify AI Project Instructions

At the start of every project session, read these repository memory files first:

- `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` for the current architecture, product scope, data flow, commands, and module boundaries.
- `docs/implement-notes.html` for recent implementation decisions and change history.

Follow the root `AGENTS.md` policy. In short:

- Any source code, configuration, workflow, dependency, API, storage, UI, test, or architecture change must be logged in `docs/implement-notes.html`.
- Notes must be written in Vietnamese as newest-first HTML cards. Each card header must include timestamp and note author from `git config user.name` or the GitHub remote username fallback.
- Update `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` immediately when usage, data flow, module boundaries, commands, dependencies, or architecture decisions change.
- If `docs/implement-notes.html` has merge conflicts, preserve valid cards, sort by timestamp descending, evaluate effectiveness of overlapping notes, then resolve.
- Prefer small meaningful commits and push after verified changes when the task calls for repository updates.
